rationale: New files in the exported render directory: the typed GPU pass API (gpu_pass, gpu_capabilities, wgsl_diagnostics), its Dawn implementation, the WGSL compile helper shared with the build-time validator, and the padded-row readback helper Renderer3D now uses. The API obtains its device only from the forwarded GpuSurface (pulp/render/gpu_surface.hpp, which names gpu_runtime::GpuSurface on macOS) and never creates a second Dawn device. Vellum reimplements this contract rather than inheriting the files, so the next re-export does not carry them.
